content.short: Fast crypto trading bot on Telegram and web, with sniping, copy trading and prediction markets.
content.description: Banana Gun started as a Telegram bot for sniping new token launches and has grown into a full terminal, Banana Pro, with wallet tracking, DCA, limit orders and copy trading. It covers eight chains including Ethereum, Solana, Base, BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain, adds MEV protection and anti-rug checks, and now runs Banana Predict for betting on events. Users have made over 26 million trades worth more than $16 billion.
content.meta: Snipe launches, copy wallets and trade prediction markets with Banana Gun's Telegram bot and Banana Pro terminal across 8 chains.
